title: antirrhinum majus var. typicum
intro: Antirrhinum majus var. typicum, commonly known as the common snapdragon, is a flowering plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. The health benefits of Antirrhinum majus var. typicum include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and to have antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diaphoretic and an expectorant, helping to induce sweating and relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Antirrhinum majus var. typicum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides.
